On 12 December 2021, in Cumana (Sucre), two members of El Yiyi y Machito organized crime group broke into a house and opened fire on the inhabitants, killing three and wounding two before fleeing on a motorcycle. The victims were family members of the leader of a rival crime group in Zulia state, leading officials to believe the attack was part of a wider war between groups. 2 injured, 3 fatalities.

On 23 February 2023, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), four unidentified crime group suspects on two motorcycles shot and injured three civilians, including a teenage boy, in a drive-by shooting in the Santa Teresa parish. The victims were outside a motorcycle repair shop; they were taken to hospital for treatment. One of them died, supposedly the initial target of the attack, which is thought to be related to territorial disputes between criminal gangs. One of the perpetrators was arrested several weeks later. 1 fatality.

On 28 March 2023, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), a group of active and retired state workers protested against the recently revealed corruption scandal within the state-owned PDVSA oil company. The protesters gathered outside the SUNACRIP national cryptocurrency office, where they blew whistles and chanted slogans.

On 27 March 2023, in San Juan de los Morros (Guarico), a group of demonstrators, including teachers, health workers, other state workers, and unionists, protested to demand better pay and working conditions, and against the corruption scandal within the state-owned PDVSA oil company that transpired in the days prior. The protesters gathered in the Los Samanes Square, and marched down the Bolivar Avenue.
On 18 May 2023, in Bruzual municipality (coded to Chivacoa, Yaracuy), a group of demonstrators marched to demand better pay and working conditions.

On 1 September 2023, in El Tigre (Anzoategui), a group of residents of the La California neighborhood protested over water outages going on for at least 15 days. The protesters blame the Hidrocaribe water company for the outages, and demand attention from the authorities.

On 7 September 2023, in Caracas - El Hatillo (Miranda), for the second consecutive day, a group of residents of the El Cigarral neighborhood staged a pot-banging protest from their balconies against the construction of a Mega Traki shopping mall in the area. They claim that it generates noise pollution.

On 25 January 2024, in Maracay (Aragua), several unidentified crime group suspects travelling in a pickup truck clashed with Aragua state police officers, killing one officer, in an armed confrontation in the Los Samanes neighborhood. The suspects had previously abducted a businessman in a nearby location, for whose liberation they were demanding a ransom, but due to pressure from the security forces they had decided to let him free. It is at that moment that they spot some police officers, they resist authority, and a shooting breaks out. One police officer and a civilian were killed in the gunfire. Another man was injured, although it is unknown whether he was a police officer or just a bystander. The shooters escaped; some sources claim that a second shooting with security forces broke out in the road towards Palito Negro, but this could not be confirmed. There is no confirmation of the liberation of the hostage at this point in time. 2 fatalities.

On 23 July 2024, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), a group of cancer patients and their relatives protested to demand the provision of a drug required for their cancer treatments at subsidized prices. According to them, the IVSS Alto Costo Social Security pharmacies have not been handing out this medicine in over three months, but there are other private pharmacies and private health centers that do sell this product at unaffordable prices. They argue that several patients have died during the interlude. They gathered outside the Health Ministry, where they spoke with several officials who claimed that Venezuela has difficulties in obtaining the drug due to the international sanctions imposed on the country.

On 20 July 2024, in Quebrada Seca (Barinas), a group of residents protested to demand the paving of the Intercomunal de Barinas road as, according to them, its current state poses a risk to road safety. They specifically demand the asphalting of the Olmedillo - Quebrada Seca section of that road. They demand action from the Corsobain roadworks company.

On 22 July 2024, in Caracas - Chacao (Miranda), a group of demonstrators, including members of the women's section of the FAVL political front, the LCR opposition party, and civil society representatives, took to the streets to demand the cessation of political violence and violence against women, and free elections, and in support of Edmundo Gonzalez Urrutia (MUD/PUEDE) in the presidential election.
On 23 July 2024, in Los Teques (Miranda), a group of residents of several sectors, including El Trigo neighborhood, staged a pot-banging protest against ongoing power outages.

On 23 July 2024, in Libertador municipality (coded to Caracas - Libertador, Distrito Capital), a group of residents of the Las Majadas sector blocked both carriageways of the Carretera Vieja Caracas - Los Teques road in protest over power outages going on for at least 24 hours, and to demand action from the Corpoelec power company.

On 20 July 2024, in La Toscana (Monagas), a grenade was detonated by a house in unclear circumstances killing two men, injuring a woman, and causing extensive property damage. Police are considering two hypotheses. On the one hand, that the grenade may have been hurled at the house by an unidentified crime group suspect, possibly involving extortion or disputes between gangs; and on the other, that the victims were renting the house, that there were explosives in the premises, and that it could have been an accidental detonation. There is no further information at this point in time. 2 fatalities.

On 25 July 2024, in Coro (Falcon), a group of residents of the San Jose sector blocked the Variante Jose Leonardo Chirinos road with branches in protest over power outages going on for two days, and to demand solutions from the Corpoelec power company.
On 26 July 2024, in Barinas state (coded to Barinas), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to private property, justice, and petrol.
On 26 July 2024, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to private property, justice, and petrol.
On 26 July 2024, in Portuguesa state (coded to Guanare), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to private property, justice, and petrol.

Other: On 26 July 2024, in Distrito Capital state (coded to Caracas - Libertador), members of MUD/PUEDE, PJ, EC, and other opposition parties reported at least 60 instances of irregularities in the setting up of polling stations across the 23 states of the country, ahead of the 28 July Presidential Election. These claims revolved around three main points: the process in some voting stations started earlier than what was stipulated in the National Electoral Council (CNE) schedule, so some poll watchers could not supervise the process from the beginning; secondly, some people who did not have the necessary accreditation, or who directly had fake CNE accreditations, participated in the process; lastly, some poll watchers were not allowed to enter the voting centers because of discrepancies in the electoral lists. In some remote areas of the country, there were also reports of voting machines not being delivered on time. All in all, opposition party leaders confirmed that these irregularities happened in less than 1% of all the polling stations in the country.

On 26 October 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), approximately 380 demonstrators, including informal sellers and representatives of the ASI Trade Union Alliance, protested to demand their right to work, to meet with the San Cristobal mayor, and to call for the cessation of evictions against them from the streets in the city center. They gathered in the 7th Avenue.

On 24 October 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including teachers and representatives of the Tachira state Education Sector Workers' Union, protested to demand better pay and working conditions, the renewal of their collective labor agreement, payment of owed stipends, and the opening of a public inquiry to investigate possible human rights violations against unionist leaders imprisoned by the government. They gathered outside the Public Ministry office, where they handed in a letter with their demands.

Around 30 October 2023 (as reported), in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including teachers, residents, and housewives, protested against the fines imposed by the Corpoelec power company to all those who did not sign up to the new Borron y Cuenta Nueva scheme. This scheme intends to cancel pre-existing debts of Corpoelec's customers, so that they can regularize their situation and get back to paying their bills. They gathered outside the Ombudsman Office, where they handed in a letter with their demands.

On 6 November 2023, in Santa Teresa del Tuy (Miranda), a group of demonstrators, including PSUV supporters, and the Santa Teresa del Tuy mayor (PSUV), marched to support Venezuela in its ongoing international territorial dispute over the Esequibo territories currently belonging to Guyana, and in favor of the Esequibo territories referendum, scheduled for 3 December 2023. They marched to the Ciudad Lozada neighborhood. This was one of the dozens of pro-Esequibo annexation marches staged that day. According to the government, a total of 335 marches were held that day, one per each Venezuelan municipality, but these claims could not be independently verified.

On 6 November 2023, in Santa Lucia (Miranda), a group of demonstrators, including PSUV supporters, and the Paz Castillo municipality mayor (PSUV), marched to support Venezuela in its ongoing international territorial dispute over the Esequibo territories currently belonging to Guyana, and in favor of the Esequibo territories referendum, scheduled for 3 December 2023. They marched to the Simon Bolivar Square. This was one of the dozens of pro-Esequibo annexation marches staged that day. According to the government, a total of 335 marches were held that day, one per each Venezuelan municipality, but these claims could not be independently verified.

On 6 November 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including PSUV supporters, and the Tachira state governor (PSUV), marched to support Venezuela in its ongoing international territorial dispute over the Esequibo territories currently belonging to Guyana, and in favor of the Esequibo territories referendum, scheduled for 3 December 2023. This was one of the dozens of pro-Esequibo annexation marches staged that day. According to the government, a total of 335 marches were held that day, one per each Venezuelan municipality, but these claims could not be independently verified.

On 9 November 2023, near Guacara village (Carabobo), a group of demonstrators, including teachers, health workers, and workers at the Carabobo University (UC), protested after the coach in which they were travelling to Caracas to attend the large demonstration planned for that day (coded separately), was stopped by GNB military forces. The protest was staged at the Guacara toll gate, in the Autovia Regional del Centro Highway. After some minutes the protesters decided to return to Valencia (Carabobo), where they ended protesting again (coded separately).

On 14 November 2023, in Guacara (Carabobo), CICPC police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, during an armed clash in the Los Mangos de Yagua sector. The suspect resisted authority and was killed in the gunfire. He was linked to thefts and abductions. Police collected a gun. 1 fatality.
On 15 November 2023, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to labor and housing.

On 23 November 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), dozens of demonstrators, including residents, and representatives of the Committee for the Defense of Users of Essential Services, protested against the poor state of these, and against the fines imposed by the Corpoelec power company to all those who did not sign up to the new Borron y Cuenta Nueva scheme. This scheme intends to cancel pre-existing debts of Corpoelec's customers, so that they can regularize their situation and get back to paying their bills. They gathered outside the Corpoelec power company office. Some of the protesters symbolically dressed up as 'Lloronas', translated to 'Weeping Women', a mythical ghost part of Venezuelan folklore.

On 30 November 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of residents and representatives of the Committee for the Defense of Users of Essential Services (CUSP), mostly women, protested against the poor internet and phone services provided by the CANTV telecom company, and their elevated prices. Some of the protesters symbolically dressed up as 'Miss Bureaucracy', 'Miss Breakdown', and 'Miss Elevated Bills'. They gathered outside the CANTV office.

On 28 November 2023, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to labor, healthcare, identity, education, political participation, and security.
On 4 December 2023, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to housing.

On 5 December 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including active and retired teachers, and representatives of the Tachira state Unitary Teachers' Union (SUMA-ET), protested to demand better pay and working conditions, payment of owed stipends, and the restoration of their medical insurance plans (HCM). They gathered outside the San Cristobal Town hall, where they met with officials who admitted that the municipality cannot provide any pay rises due to budgetary problems; instead of these, the local authorities have suggested reducing their workweek to two days.

On 8 December 2023, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including relatives of political prisoners, civil society representatives, human rights activists, and EC political party representatives, protested to demand the liberation of all political prisoners before Christmas, and the closing down of what they deem as torture centers. They gathered in the Los Mangos Square.

On 18 December 2023, in Los Guayos (Carabobo), CICPC police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, during an armed clash in the Paraparal neighborhood. The suspect resisted authority, opened fire on the officers, was injured in the gunfire, and pronounced dead in hospital. He had a criminal record for drug trafficking, theft, and violence. 1 fatality.
On 15 December 2023, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to housing, labor, life, healthcare, and social security.
On 20 December 2023, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to labor and essential services.

They gathered in the El Educador roundabout, and then marched to the Education Zone Office. Tachira state police forces were present but there was no intervention. This was one of the dozens of simultaneous nationwide demonstrations staged by teachers and other state workers that day.

On 15 January 2024, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a large group of demonstrators, including school and university teachers, other state workers, and representatives of the Tachira state Union Coalition Workers' Union, and the Tachira state National Experimental University, the FENATEV, and the FETRA Ensenanza teachers' unions, protested to demand better pay and working conditions, and the renewal of their collective labor agreements. They gathered outside the Labor Inspectorate Office, where they handed in a letter with their demands. This was one of the dozens of simultaneous nationwide demonstrations staged by teachers and other state workers that day, coinciding with the Venezuelan Teachers' Day.

On 19 January 2024, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to justice, policy, labor, social security, civilian security, food, and housing.

They marched from the seat of the Tachira state government to the La Concordia sector. This was one of the several pro-government demonstrations staged by PSUV supporters that day, coinciding with the 66th anniversary of the 1958 coup, which for some marks the inception of democracy in the country, and is considered the Venezuelan Democracy Day.

On 23 January 2024, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including active and retired teachers and health workers, and representatives of the PJ and the EC opposition parties, and the Jovenes por la Democracia (Youth for Democracy) movement, protested to demand better pay, working conditions, and medical attention, and against what they deem as threats and intimidation towards opposition party members and supporters from the government (PSUV). They gathered in the Daniel Tinoco Square. This was one of the dozens of simultaneous nationwide pro-democracy demonstrations staged by active and retired state workers, pensioners, and opposition parties that day, coinciding with the 66th anniversary of the 1958 coup, which for some marks the inception of democracy in the country, and is considered the Venezuelan Democracy Day.

On 25 January 2024, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to housing, prisoner rights, justice, labor, healthcare, and political participation.
On 30 January 2024, in Tachira state (coded to San Cristobal), demonstrators protested with unspecified demands on issues related to labor, justice, housing, water, and healthcare.

Around 26 February 2024 (as reported), in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of demonstrators, including children and adolescents who play for the Iutenses Social Football Club, their parents, and managers, protested to demand permission from the authorities to use a football pitch located in the Rotaria Avenue as training grounds. The football field belongs to the UPTAIET Agricultural University. The Iutenses FC had been using that sports complex for the past 20 years, however, due to planned renovations expected to last six months, the UPTAIET dean closed it down almost a year and a half ago. Once the construction works were concluded, instead of returning the pitch to the Iutenses FC, it was handed over to the Real Frontera FC. The children, who mostly come from poor backgrounds, have now to resort to training in other pitches further away from home.

Relatives of the victim claim that the shooters were armed with rifles, but only 9mm bullet shells were found at the scene. There is no further information on the motive of the perpetrators. 1 fatality.

An adolescent boy who was present during the attack came out unscathed; one of the perpetrators was thought to have been his baseball coach in the past, which explains why the boy was not shot. The motive for the attack is unknown, but it is suspected that it could have been extortion threat related or a settling of scores. The attack was recorded by the shooters and posted on social media. There were no fatalities.

On 18 July 2019, in San Carlos del Zulia (Zulia), unidentified armed men shot dead a woman. The victim was the wife of a drug trafficker, who had been killed on 25 June. 1 fatality.

On 18 July 2019, near Santa Barbara del Zulia municipality (Zulia), two unidentified armed men on a motorcycle killed a man in a drive-by shooting in El Guanabal sector. Motivation unknown. 1 fatality.

On 23 July 2019, in Coloncito (Tachira), several unidentified armed men stormed a house, put at gunpoint a family, and kidnapped a man in Sector 19 de Abril.

On 22 September 2019, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), several unidentified armed men shot dead a man, with several bullets in his head in San Jose de Cacahual sector, San Felix. The victim had come back from an illegal mining site a few weeks earlier. 1 fatality.

Around 24 September 2019, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a man was killed and his was found in his office in the Obrero neighbourhood. The victim was a lawyer, and had his hands and feet tied, and was gagged. Motivation unknown. 1 fatality.

On 27 September 2019, in Ciudad Bolivar (Bolivar), members of an organized crime group stormed a house, put the residents at gunpoint, and shot a member of a rival gang in the Maipure neighbourhood, I sector. Around 30 September 2019, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), a man was killed and his body was found in San Jose de Cacahual sector, San Felix. The victim had been tortured to death, and it was difficult to determine his identity. 1 fatality.

The suspect resisted the authorities and stated a shooting, where he resulted injured. He was taken to the hospital, but did not survive the injuries. 1 fatality.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) CPNB: National Bolivarian Police
notes: Around 20 May 2018 (as reported), in Santa Rita (Zulia), PNB forces exchanged fire with an armed suspect at Punta Iguana Sur sector. The suspect was being accused of extorting the fishermen in the region. The suspect was shot and killed during the clash. Police seized a revolver. 1 fatality.

Property destruction: On 21 May 2018, in Bachaquero (Zulia), a group of suspects in two motorcycles threw a Molotov explosive device to the municipal police station, in Campo Progreso sector, damaging the door of the building and fled after the attack. There were no fatalities.

Around 21 May 2018 (as reported), in Santa Rita (Zulia), unknown armed criminal group suspects exchanged fire outside a polling station in the Pele el Ojo sector. Two of the suspects were shot and killed during the clash. 2 fatalities.

On 29 March 2018, in Urena (Tachira), an Urena Sports Club footballer was kidnapped by two unidentified individuals who intercepted him while riding a motorcycle on 6th Street in the Aguas Calientes neighborhood. The two armed men took the footballer to an unknown location. On 5 April 2018, the footballer was released by his captors. There is no further information.

Around 5 April 2018 (as reported), in Abejales (Tachira), a Colombian farmer was killed and his body was discovered in the Sacramento sector with two bullet wounds to the head. Authorities indicated that the perpetrators executed the farmer elsewhere and placed his body at the location where they found it. There are no reports on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

Around 5 April 2018 (as reported), in San Joaquin de Navay (Tachira), a man was killed and his body was found in a ditch along the main road. Authorities discovered the man face down with five bullet wounds to the head, indicating an execution. They suspect that the body was placed there from a different location by the perpetrators. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

Around 6 April 2018 (as reported), around Maracay (Aragua), a criminal group killed two men, injured one other, and left their bodies along the Las Delicias river in the Rio Blanco II sector. Local residents discovered the bodies of a father and son who were blindfolded with execution-style bullet wounds to the back of the head. The other man was found with bullet wounds and was taken to a local hospital. The father of the two killed victims was the owner of the Expreso Mara transport company. The two victims were previously kidnapped when a gang stole one of the company's buses. 2 fatalities.

On 6 April 2018, near Mata de Curo (Tachira), elements from the Venezuelan military opened fire on a group of men transporting gaseous urea on a road heading to Colombia, killing two men. The soldiers opened fire on the group when they did not respond to their warnings. Authorities did not confirm whether the victims of the attack were armed or if they were engaged in illegal activity, and it's unclear what happened next in the event. 2 fatalities.

On 11 April 2018, near Urena (Tachira), two unidentified armed groups clashed on the bridge between Urena and Cucuta, Colombia, on the Venezuelan side of the border. The firefight started due to the kidnapping of a man by one of the sides. There is no further information. There were no casualties.

Around 9 April 2018 (as reported), near Colon (Tachira), two unidentified men were killed and their bodies were found under a viaduct that leads into the city with their hands tied behind their back and with various gunshot wounds to the head, chest, and back. The bodies also showed evidence of bruising and torture. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 2 fatalities.

On 10 April 2018, in Cano Negro (Tachira), a truck driver was attacked and killed by an armed gang on a road in the Cano Negro sector. The report refers to the armed group as 'highway pirates' who intimidated the man and stole his NPR cargo truck. The body of the man was discovered later on the same day with its hand tied behind its back and a gunshot wound to the head in a nearby ditch. 1 fatality.

On 14 April 2018, in San Francisco (Zulia), a mob of people surrounded the house of a man, dragged him out, and beat him to death in a public lynching. The mob had discovered that the man had hit his two-year-old stepson in the abdomen, causing the boy to die. Police later arrested several of the participants of the lynching. 1 fatality.

On 18 April 2018, in La Mulera (Tachira), a Colombian man was killed while driving in his vehicle by armed men from another moving vehicle in a drive-by shooting. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 20 April 2018, in Ciudad Bolivar (Heres), CICPC police clashed with a criminal group who moments before had kidnapped a woman and stolen her vehicle. Five members of the armed gang were killed, and the woman was retrieved from the trunk of her vehicle with her hands tied behind her back. 5 fatalities.

On 19 April 2018, in La Tendida (Tachira), a male merchant was shot and killed by an armed man near the Bolivar Plaza. After shooting the merchant four times in the back, the armed man escaped on a motorcycle with a driver who was waiting for him. There is no further information on the identity of the perpetrators or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 21 April 2018, near Lobatera (Tachira), CICPC and state police forces clashed with a criminal gang consisting of various members traveling on a motorcycle and pick-up truck along the Panamerica highway in the Zaragoza sector. Police responded to reports of the gang kidnapping an NPR cargo truck driver and intercepted the gang. Two gang members were killed in the clash while another one was arrested. 2 fatalities.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) CPNB: National Bolivarian Police
notes: Around 24 April 2018 (as reported), in a rural area of Garcia de Hevia municipality (coded to Orope, Tachira), CPNB police arrested 36 informal miners who were operating in the Las Pipas ravine and confiscated their extracted gold and mining equipment. Authorities suspect that the illegal mining was connected to criminal organizations who were profiting from gold and precious mineral extraction in the local area.

On 1 April 2018, in Ciudad Bolivar (Heres), various armed men linked to criminal activity shot, stabbed, and killed a local guitarist outside of his home in the Agua Salada parish and stole his vehicle. Police later captured four of the armed men and discovered the stolen vehicle of the guitarist, which they found burned. 1 fatality.

On 25 April 2018, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a homeless woman was killed by an unidentified group who approached her shot her once in the head on a street the 8 de Diciembre neighborhood. Reports indicate that the woman was a heavy drug user and the killing is a likely result of drug-related criminal activity. 1 fatality.

On 27 April 2018, in Orope (Tachira), a man was shot six times in the head by an unidentified group in the Jose Antonio Paez parish. The man was linked to criminal activity in cattle theft, and authorities suspect that the shooting was linked to criminal activity. 1 fatality.

actor2: El Bebe de Las Palmitas Gang
notes: On 28 April 2018, in in Valencia (Carabobo), police clashed with members of El Bebe de Las Palmitas gang in the Las Palmitas sector. The clash resulted in the death of four gang members. The gang members were being persecuted for the decapitation of a woman in Valencia on 21 April 2018 (coded separately). The four gang members were killed and three police officers were injured. 4 fatalities.

Around 23 March 2018 (as reported), in the rural area of Acevedo municipality (coded to Caucagua, Miranda), an Italian merchant was killed by at least four armed individuals and his body was discovered in the La Soledad area of the municipality on 3 April 2018. The four individuals - one woman and three men - were captured by police and charged for his murder. The gang stole the man's motorcycle and shot him various times in the abdomen. 1 fatality.

Around 8 April 2018 (as reported), in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), a person was killed and their dismembered remains were left under the Francisco Fajatdo highway, next to the Mamera neighborhood. Authorities discovered the dismembered remains of four limbs - two legs and two arms - with the two arms also missing their hands. There is no further information on the identity of the perpetrators or motive of the attack. Authorities also did confirm whether the remains belonged to the same person. At least 1 fatality.

On 19 April 2018, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), a male Dominican hip hop singer was killed by two hooded individuals who approached him on Pantheon Avenue and stabbed him multiple times in the chest, back and neck, covered his face with flannel, and stole his watch and jewelry. The body of the man was found later on the same day, half-buried in an embarkment at the end of Armed Forces Avenue. Police gathered evidence as the perpetrators sent pictures of the man's body to one of his friends. There is no further information on the identity of the perpetrators or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 25 May 2018, in Maracaibo (Zulia), police forces exchanged fire with armed suspects in the Armando Rovero neighborhood, Idelfonso Vasquez parish, after the suspects resisted the authorities and started the clash. Two of them were shot and killed during the clash. 2 fatalities.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) CPNB: National Bolivarian Police
notes: On 24 May 2018, in San Francisco de Yare (Miranda), PNB forces exchanged fire with a member of the El Gordo Paz gang in the San Benito sector during a police operation. The suspect was shot and injured during the clash and was taken to the hospital, where he later died. He had criminal records for unspecified crimes. 1 fatality.

On 28 May 2018, in Jesus Enrique Lossada (Zulia), a group of locals beat a man with sticks, rocks and different objects to death. The motivation behind the attack from the group are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 31 May 2018 (as reported), in Maracaibo (Zulia), a girl was killed and her burned body was found in the Integracion Comunal neighborhood by locals. The victim went missing one day before her body was found. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 30 May 2018, in San Francisco (Zulia), a man was shot to death in a drive-by shooting at Av.8, La Punta sector by a group of armed suspects who intercepted the victim in a car, while another suspect shot him at least 15 times from a motorcycle. The victim was taken to hospital, where he later died. Police stated the victim was a customs worker and his father was a former police officer. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 1 June 2018 (as reported), in Santa Rita (Zulia), Cicpc forces exchanged fire with an armed suspect at Centenares Av. During a police operation aiming to arrest the suspect, who was accused of participating in five homicides. The suspect resisted the authorities and started the clash, where he ended injured and was taken to hospital, but did not survive the injuries. Police seized a revolver with the suspect. 1 fatality.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) FAES: Special Action Forces
notes: On 2 June 2018, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), FAES police special forces shot and killed an El Chato gang member, during an armed confrontation in the La Union neighborhood, San Juan parish. The suspect resisted authority, opened fire on the police unit, and was injured in the gunfire. He died while being transported to hospital for treatment. The deceased was thought to be the leader of the gang, which carries out vehicle thefts in the city, and was linked to the killing of a musician during a robbery the week before (coded separately). Three other suspects were arrested during a security operation. 1 fatality.

On 4 June 2018, in Maracaibo (Zulia), police forces exchanged fire with a gang suspect member in the Los Robles neighborhood during a police operation aiming to arrest the suspect, who was between the 10th most wanted criminals of the Interpol police. The suspect resisted the authority and was shot and injured and taken to hospital, where he later died. He had a criminal record for homicide. 1 fatality.

Around 11 June 2018 (as reported), in Maracaibo (Zulia), police forces exchanged fire with the second in charged of the El Cagon gang in the Hato Viejo sector, Cristo de Aranza parish during a police operation. The suspect was shot and killed during the clash. 1 fatality.

On 6 July 2018, in Santa Rita (Zulia), a public prosecutor at the National Superintendence for the Defense of Social and Economic Rights (SUNDDE) and her husband were shot to death in a drive-by shooting outside their house in the Simon Bolivar neighborhood by two armed suspects in a motorcycle who opened fire killing both victims. Witnesses stated that both victims had received threats from extorting gangs that operate in the region. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 2 fatalities.

On 9 July 2018, in Maracaibo (Zulia), Cicpc forces exchanged fire with armed group suspects near Los Olivos complex, Caraccioo Parra Perez parish during a police operation. The suspects were accused of extortion and also theft in the area. 2 fatalities.

On 14 July 2018, in San Carlos (Zulia), a member of the Wayuu Indigenous community was shot to death by members of an unidentified gang in the Toas island after the victim had refused to steal electric cable from the locality. The perpetrators behind the attack are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 19 July 2018, in Maracaibo (Zulia), Maracaibo police forces opened fire against a ship's lieutenant and a Miranda police officer at Puntica de Piedra sector injuring both. They were taken to hospital but did not survive the injuries. It's unclear if the lieutenant also fired against the officers, his relatives stated the victim did not exchange fire and that he was just shot dead by the officers. 2 fatalities.

On 18 July 2018, in San Francisco (Zulia), Cicpc forces exchanged fire with members of the Los Cascaras gang at Km 18, near Los Parisi, in the Los Cortijos parish during a police operation. Three suspects, including the gang's leader, were shot and injured during the clash and were taken to hospital, where they later died. 3 fatalities.

On 20 July 2018, in San Timoteo (Zulia), Cicpc forces exchanged fire with a member of the Los Viatas gang in La Linea sector, Libertador parish during a police operation. The suspect resisted the authorities and opened fire against the officers, resulting injured during the clash. He was taken to hospital but did not survive the injuries. Police seized a pistol. 1 fatality.

On 16 July 2018, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), Cicpc police forces and a hooded former police officer broke into a man's house in El Cipres de Las Adjuntas sector, and opened fire killing him, after having forced the relatives of the victim out of the house, where the attack took place. Relatives of the man stated the attack was perpetuated by the former officer as retaliation for a personal discussion the victim and the officer had days before, and ensure the attack was an extra judicial killing, since there was no gunfire exchanged. The deceased victim was recently released from prison for drug possession. At the same time, officers broke into a man's house at Cacique Tiuna apartment complex, and according to relatives, the officers stabbed and shot to death a man, after having forced the relatives out of the house. The motives of the attack are this attack are the same as the first. 2 fatalities.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) CPNB: National Bolivarian Police
notes: On 30 July 2018, in Maracaibo (Zulia), CPNB forces exchanged fire with a suspected gang leader in the Las Canaimas neighborhood, Haticos sector, during a police operation. The suspect resisted the authority and opened fire against the officers, starting the clash. He was shot and injured and taken to hospital, where he later died. 1 fatality.

On 2 August 2018, in Maracaibo (Zulia), relatives of 12 police members that were arrested carried out a demonstration outside the court house demanding celerity in the process against the officers accused by a civilian with several charges.

Around 5 August 2018 (as reported), in Ciudad Ojeda (Zulia), a man was killed and his body was found with hands and feet tied up inside his house at L sector. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 1 fatality.

actor1: Military Forces of Venezuela (1999-) GNB: Venezuelan National Guard
notes: On 7 August 2018, in Los Puertos de Altagracia (Zulia), GNB forces exchanged fire with armed gang member suspects in the Pueblo Nuevo sector, after the officers chased after the individuals. During the clash 4 of the suspects, who were also linked to extorting activities in the area, were shot and injured and taken to hospital, but did not survive the injuries. 4 fatalities.

actor1: Military Forces of Venezuela (1999-) GNB: Venezuelan National Guard
notes: Property destruction: Around 15 August 2018 (as reported), in Zulia state (coded to El Cruce, Zulia), military forces seized and destroyed at least 3 tons of cocaine and destroyed 4 cocaine labs in the border region with Colombia. Other cocaine precursors were also seized during the operation. No fatalities or arrests were reported.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) FAES: Special Action Forces
notes: Around 1 June 2018 (as reported), in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), 400 FAES police officers clashed with a criminal armed group near the Primero de Mayo Bolivarian School in the El Cementerio sector of Santa Rosalia parish. Three armed men died in the firefight. 3 fatalities.

Around 30 May 2018 (as reported), in Maracaibo (Zulia), a young girl was raped, killed and her body was burned and left in a dumpster along 23 Avenue and 139 Street within the industrial zone of Maracaibo. The killing was related to a criminal group human trafficking ring. Seven people were identified as the perpetrators, one of whom was arrested in 2019. 1 fatality.

On 3 June 2018, in Colon (Tachira), a man was shot and killed by two armed men on a motorcycle in a drive-by shooting near the old Plaza de Toros. There is no information on the perpetrators or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 5 June 2018, in El Molino (Tachira), six hooded armed men riding a pick-up truck shot at a male motorcyclist in a drive-by shooting along the road to Peribeca going through the village. The armed men pulled up the motorcyclist and shot him in the back and the leg, but the motorcyclist managed to get away. There is no further information on the perpetrators or motive of the attack. There were no fatalities.

On 11 June 2018, in Los Guayos (Carabobo), police forces attempted to arrest a known male criminal gang leader of Los Come Queso gang, who opened fire on them resulting in a firefight. The man was killed during the confrontation. He was on listed as a top wanted criminal by Venezuelan authorities. 1 fatality.

On 10 June 2018, in Colon (Tachira), an armed clash occurred between two criminal groups in the Che Guevara sector, resulting in one man being shot and killed. Authorities identified that one of the groups belong to the Los Negros Gang. 1 fatality.

On 12 June 2018, near La Fria (Tachira), a clash occurred between CICPC police and two members of the Los Rastrojos Gang near the San Felix sports field, where the two men resisted arrest and shot at police. Both men were killed in the resulting firefight. 2 fatalities.

On 12 June 2018, in Coloncito (Tachira), three teenagers - one boy and two girls - were kidnapped by various unidentified men traveling in a van in the 19 de Abril neighborhood. The two girls were released by the captors on the same day, while the whereabouts of the boy remain unknown.

On 13 June 2018, in El Palotal (Tachira), two unidentified armed men on a motorcycle shot and killed a man in a drive-by shooting after they intercepted him on the street. Authorities indicate that the attack was likely motivated by a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

Around 18 June 2018 (as reported), in the rural area of Rubio (Tachira), two brothers were killed and their bodies were found with gunshot wounds to the back of the head (tiro de gracia), and with signs of torture, in the rural La Vuelta de la Oreja sector along the road toward Cuqui village. There is no information on the perpetrators or motive of the attack. 2 fatalities.

actor1: Military Forces of Venezuela (1999-) GNB: Venezuelan National Guard
notes: On 20 June 2018, near Tocuyito (Carabobo), a clash occurred between GNB military forces and an unidentified armed group along the Carretera Vieja road toward La Guasima. A family that was driving by was caught by crossfire during the clash, resulting in the injuries of a man and a woman and the death of a 1-year-old girl. 1 fatality.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) FAES: Special Action Forces
notes: On 18 June 2018, in Caracas - Sucre (Miranda), FAES and PNB police killed a man in his house in the Petare parish, El Campito neighborhood. Relatives of the man reported that police unjustly executed the man. 1 fatality.

On 19 June 2018, in El Palotal (Tachira), two unidentified armed men shot at a male taxi driver and a woman accompanying him along the San Antonio-Urena highway, within the Virgen de la Luz park at the entrance of the town. The taxi driver was killed while the woman was injured. There is no information on the perpetrators or motivation of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 13 June 2018, in El Palotal (Tachira), two unidentified armed men shot and killed a man along the San Antonio-Urena highway, within the Virgen de la Luz park at the entrance of the town. The man was shot twice in the head. There is no information on the perpetrators or motivation of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 22 June 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), police clashed with three armed men belonging to a criminal group along 13th Street in the center of the town. The three men were being tracked by police after they robbed and killed a gas-station owner earlier in the day (coded separately). The three men were killed by police in the resulting gunfight. 3 fatalities.

On 24 June 2018, in Colon (Tachira), in an armed clash between the Los Rastrojos and the Gulf Clan, two armed men intercepted, shot and killed a young man close to the old Plaza de Toros along 5th and 6th street. Another young man was also injured during the attack. Reports do not indicate to which gang the killed man belong to, or whether the other injured man also belonged to one of the gangs. 1 fatality.

actor1: Military Forces of Venezuela (1999-) GNB: Venezuelan National Guard
notes: On 23 June 2018, in Urena (Tachira), GNB forces clashed with an armed members from the El Escobal Gulf Clan in the Las Columnas neighborhood close to the Colombian-Venezuelan border. Two of the armed group members were injured during the clash and died later at a hospital. Authorities confiscated various weapons and ammunition, a motorcycle, and pamphlets belonging to the organization. Three teenagers who participated in the clash were also arrested - one Venezuelan and two Colombian. 2 fatalities.

On 24 June 2018, near Boca de Grita (Tachira), local residents blocked kilometer 96 of the La Fria-Machiques highway to express their support of the residents of Orope, who hindered FAES police forces conducting an operation in their town by blocking a road and throwing rocks at them (coded separately). The residents of Boca de Grita protested in solidarity with Orope residents who wanted police to leave the area.

On 28 June 2018, in Colon (Tachira), five armed men shot and killed a male taxi driver in the El Milagro neighborhood. Authorities suspect this attack to be a part of an ongoing struggle between the Los Rastrojos y Los Urabenos (Gulf Clan) gangs in the area. 1 fatality.

Around 2 May 2018 (as reported), near San Josecito (Tachira), a man was shot and killed and his body was found with multiple bullet wounds and with his hands tied behind the back on the side of the T-5 highway in the Los Galpones sector. Authorities suspect that the body was placed there by the perpetrators from a different location. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 4 May 2018, in Barquisimeto (Lara), five armed individuals exchanged fire with CICPC and CPNB police officers after they took a bus and 20 people hostage along Venezuela Avenue and 22nd Street. Police arrested the five individuals - three men and two women - and they were later charged with assault and kidnapping. There were no casualties.

actor1: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) CPNB: National Bolivarian Police
notes: On 7 May 2018, Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), two armed men who had previously intercepted and attacked two off-duty police officers exchanged fire with a passing CPNB patrol moments after the attack. Reports indicate that one of the armed men opened fire on the police patrol first. One of the perpetrators was killed while the other was arrested after an attempted escape. Moments before, the two armed men intercepted two off-duty police officers outside of their home along San Martin Avenue and shot them, killing one officer and injuring the other. The police officers were a married couple who were leaving their apartment building on a KLR motorcycle with their child, who was not injured in the attack. The woman, who was killed, was a CPNB officer. Her male partner, who was injured and taken to the hospital, was a CICPC officer. 2 fatalities.

On 5 May 2018, in La Grita (Tachira), a man was shot and killed by CICPC and CPNB police forces at his residence in the presence of family. Family members rejected the official version of a clash from police forces, reporting that the crime was an extrajudicial killing. The man had gotten into a car crash along Caceres Avenue earlier in the day, injuring a man and his son, and escaped the scene as some individuals shot at him as a result. Family members claimed that the man understood that police arrived to his residence to arrest him and was prepared to turn himself in, but that police ambushed him and placed a weapon on his body afterward. 1 fatality.

On 6 May 2018, in La Morita (Tachira), two young men were kidnapped by armed individuals traveling on a vehicle in the El Pinal sector and were shortly after killed. The armed individuals executed the two men with several gunshots to the back of their heads (tiros de gracia) and dumped their bodies along the main road of La Morita. The bodies were discovered by local residents who reported hearing gunshots and went to investigate. 2 fatalities.

actor1: Military Forces of Venezuela (1999-) Bolivarian Militia of Venezuela (MNB)
notes: On 1 April 2018, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), a soldier of the Bolivarian Militia and a security guard of the Antonio Jose de Sucre Hydroelectric Power Plant shot and killed a man whom they accused of stealing copper from the plant. The soldier and security guard decapitated the dead man and hid his body in a nearby wooded area. The man was accompanied by another who was captured by the soldier and security guard and turned over to municipal police. The soldier and body guard were later arrested and charged of homicide for the attack. 1 fatality.

On 7 May 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), two unidentified individuals dressed in black and carrying automatic rifles shot at a group of four people who were standing outside of a liquor store along the Aeropuerto avenue. The armed individuals approached the liquor store on a motorcycle and got off to open fire on two men and two women, killing both men and injuring the women. There is no further information on the identity of the perpetrators or motive of the attack. 2 fatalities.

Around 9 May 2018 (as reported), in the rural area of Torbes municipality (coded to San Josecito, Tachira), an unidentified man was killed and his body was discovered on the side of the T-5 highway in the Las Parcelas sector. The body was discovered with three shots to the head. The residents of the municipality attributed the attack to that of irregular criminal groups that operate in the area. 1 fatality.

On 11 May 2018, near Santa Ana del Tachira (Tachira), two men were killed by armed men who arrived to meet them on a motorcycle in the Bello Monte sector, on a road adjacent to the entrance of the town. Authorities suspect that both parties were involved in criminal activity, and that the two men on a motorcycle lured the two victims for a meeting in a remote location to ambush and kill them. None of the men were thought to be locals of the area. 2 fatalities.

On 10 May 2018, in La Tendida (Tachira), CICPC and FAES police forces clashed with members of the El Zoologico Gang. The leader of the group was killed while other group members escaped. The group operates in the northern part of Tachira in food and fuel smuggling, as well as extortion. 1 fatality.

On 10 May 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), two armed men riding on a motorcycle killed a male teenager in a drive-by shooting at a soccer field in the Las Americas neighborhood. The armed men shot at the teenager while he was sitting on a bench with his brother, who was injured in the attack. Authorities suspect the attack to be a retaliation or settling of scores, as the teenager was discovered to be selling drugs in the area. 1 fatality.

On 11 May 2018, in Colon (Tachira), two armed men shot and killed a man at the front of his house in the Cristobal Colon neighborhood. The two men stopped at the front of the house and shot the man multiple times before escaping. Authorities suspect a settling of scores and the armed men to be hired hitmen. 1 fatality.

On 12 May 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), two armed individuals killed a man while he was walking on a sidewalk in a drive-by shooting in the El Cementerio neighborhood. The armed individuals were hitmen sent by the Los Urabenos Gang for a settlement of scores. 1 fatality.

On 12 May 2018, in Urena (Tachira), four armed individuals riding motorcycles shot at a tobacco bar in a drive-by shooting in the La Cruz neighborhood. A male Colombian merchant was hit three times and driven by his family members across the Francisco de Paula Santander international bridge to Colombia, where he died from his wounds. Venezuelan police suspect the shooting to be a result of a shooting between a taxi driver and other armed men, but no further information is available. 1 fatality.

On 15 May 2018, in Urena (Tachira), CICPC and FAES officers clashed with two members of the Border Paramilitary Organization (OPF) criminal group in the Che Guevara sector of Urena. The two men were identified as the two men responsible for throwing a grenade from a motorcycle at the Civic Center of San Antonio del Tachira on 25 April 2018 (coded separately). The two men were caught on camera during the attack, allowing police to track them down, resulting in a gunfight. 2 fatalities.

actor2: Police Forces of Venezuela (1999-) Prison Guards
notes: On 17 May 2018, near Tamaca (Lara), a group of inmates from the Fenix Penitentiary rioted in response of a fire in a prison cell in Valencia on 28 March that killed 68 prisoners. The prisoners clashed with security personnel and overwhelmed and killed two prison guards with their own firearms and took various hostages with make-shift knives. A local NGO reported 11 people killed as a result of the riot, including two guards and 9 prisoners, with an additional 25 people left injured. Officers of the Bolivarian National Guard entered the detention center on request of prison officials and regained control. 11 fatalities.

On 16 May 2018, in Urena (Tachira), CICPC offers clashed with members of a criminal group traveling in a Chevrolet truck in the Bolivariano neighborhood. The officers attempted to stop the vehicle for an inspection in response to local reports of criminal activity, resulting in an exchange of gunfire when the group refused to stop the vehicle. Two of the group members were killed while the remainder escaped on foot. Sources differ on whether the group belonged to the Border Paramilitary Organization (OPF) or the Gulf Clan. 2 fatalities.

actor1: Military Forces of Venezuela (1999-) GNB: Venezuelan National Guard
notes: On 17 May 2018, in Urena (Tachira), an unidentified armed group attacked a military installation belonging to the Bolivarian National Guard with heavy weaponry, resulting in a firefight between the group and military personnel. The group eventually retreated into a wooded area closed to the Tachira River. There were no casualties.

On 20 May 2018, in Cabimas (Zulia), a group of rioters interfered with the electrical system of the Barlovento electrical substation. The Minister of Energy accused the group of intending to sabotage the presidential and legislative council elections happening that day. 10 people were arrested for election interference, with three of them accused by authorities of trying to steal important material for the operation of the substation.

On 20 May 2018, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of people from the community of the San Francisco neighborhood took to the streets to protest the results of the presidential election. An armed motorcyclist who belonged to a local collective fired into the crowd of protesters, injuring two boys who were in their homes with stray bullets. There were no fatalities.

Around 21 May 2018 (as reported), in San Antonio del Tachira (Tachira), a man was killed and his body was found on a road behind a school in the Rafel Urdaneta sector. The body was found blindfolded, with two gunshot wounds to the head, and with the hands and feet tied with ropes. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack, but authorities suspect a connection to criminal activity as the man was known to be a local thief. 1 fatality.

On 24 May 2018, in Santa Ana del Tachira (Tachira), several hooded men belonging to The Dwarf Gang intercepted and killed an off-duty prison guard who was leaving his house in the Eleazar Lopez Contreras neighborhood, in the Sabaneta sector. The hooded men ambushed the prison guard and shot him in the face, immediately killing him, and stole and burned his motorcycle. Authorities revealed that the gang members likely killed the victim because he was the brother-in-law of the leader of a competing gang. 1 fatality.

On 27 May 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), a male mechanic was killed by two armed men in a drive-by shooting while he was walking along 2nd Street in front of the La Fria Fire Department. Police suspect the motive of the attack to be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 27 May 2018, Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), armed men on motorcycles intercepted and shot a car carrying three people in a drive-by shooting in the Gonzalez Cabrera sector, in the El Junquito parish. A pregnant woman was shot in the head and killed, while her two male relatives were non-fatally injured with gunshot wounds. The baby survived through an emergency operation. Authorities suspect that it may have been the woman's partner who ordered the attack with hitmen was the woman showed signs of domestic violence, but little information is available on the motivation of the attack. 1 fatality.

Around 30 May 2018 (as reported), in Maracaibo (Zulia), an unidentified teenage boy was killed and his burned body was discovered among garbage and rubble along Avenue 129 of the Industrial Zone of Maracaibo. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 28 May 2018, in San Josecito (Tachira), three unidentified men shot and killed an ex-inmate in his home in the La Montanita neighborhood. The armed men broke into the home of the victim three days after he left jail, shooting him and fleeing the scene. Authorities suspect a settling of accounts as the motivation for the attack. 1 fatality.

On 31 May 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), various hooded armed individuals approached a man and shot him multiple times in the head and chest, killing him in the Che Guevara sector. The hooded men fled in an unspecified vehicle. There is no information on the identity of the perpetrators, circumstances of death, or motive of the attack. 1 fatality.

On 27 May 2018, in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), three municipal police officers kidnapped a couple - a man and a woman - along Teresa de la Parra avenue to demand a ransom of 170 million bolivars. The couple was released after a payment was made, and the officers were arrested the next day.

On 17 August 2018, in La Canada de Urdaneta (Zulia), a group of locals carried out riots in the municipality repudiating the electricity outages that they had been having for several days. Rioters started the demonstration by carrying out a pot-banging and then broke into the city hall and set up fire to different objects and looted some food. Objects were also set on fire in the police station. Barricades were set in different avenues and close to the localities affected by the electricity outages.

On 27 August 2018, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), CICPC forces exchanged fire with armed gang members suspects at Av. Atlantico, in Puerto Ordaz locality, after police forces chased after the suspects and they resisted the authorities opening fire against the agents. Two suspects, posing as police officers and accused of drug trafficking and homicide, were shot and injured during the clash and were taken to hospital but did not survive the injuries. 2 fatalities.

On 28 August 2018, in Lagunillas (Zulia), a man was shot to death in a drive-by shooting in the Las Morochas neighborhood by two armed suspects in a motorcycle and opened fire against the victim shooting him at least 12 times. Police believes the attack was a settlement of scores. The perpetrators behind the attack are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 12 September 2018 (as reported), in Ciudad Bolivar (Bolivar), an off-duty police officer was killed and his burned body was found inside his car in a parking area of a wooded area. Around 13 September 2018 (as reported), in San Francisco (Zulia), police forces exchanged fire with an armed gang member suspect in Villa Margarita neighborhood, San Benito 2 neighborhood, Marcial Hernandez parish during a police operation. On 13 September 2018, in Maracaibo - Idelfonso Vasquez (Zulia), DIEP police forces exchanged fire with members of the Javielito gang in the Cujicito neighborhood, Idelfonso Vasquez parish during police patrol in the area. The suspects resisted the authority and opened fire against the officers starting the clash. On 25 August 2018, in Alto Viento (Zulia), a man was shot to death by members of the Los Viatas gang in the La Reinita farm, in the municipality after the victim had resisted paying extortion payments to the gang. 1 fatality.

On 9 September 2018, in Caripito (Monagas), two men were beaten by a group of locals, including the mayor (PSUV) of the municipality in a party. After being severely beaten the victims were taken to a property of one of the perpetrators of the attack, where one of the victims died. The victims were transported in an official vehicle belonging to the municpality. The motivation behind the attack were no reported. The perpetrators were arrested days after. 1 fatality.

On 5 October 2018, near Cabimas (Zulia), two police officers were abducted and killed by unknown armed suspects who intercepted the victims in the road Lara - Zulia. Police stated the victims were shot at least 50 times. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 2 fatalities.

On 10 October 2018, in Maracaibo - Manuel Dagnino (Zulia), police forces exchanged fire with armed suspects near Pomona bridge, in the Maria Concepcion Palacios neighborhood. The suspects were shot and injured during the clash and taken to hospital, but did not survive the injuries. They were suspected to be involved in the killing of a taxi driver days before during theft. 2 fatalities.

Around 15 October 2018 (as reported), in La Canada de Urdaneta (Zulia), two men were killed and their bodies were found with sings of torture and hands tied up in the road to El Carmelo municipality, near the Chivito hardware store. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 2 fatalities.

On 14 October 2018, in Porlamar (Nueva Esparta), a group of prisoners carried out a riot in the Los Cocos detention center. During the riot at least 40 prisoners escaped the facility and two inmates were killed by some of the rioters who fled. 2 fatalities.

Around 14 October 2018 (as reported), in La Villa del Rosario (Zulia), CICPC forces exchanged fire with an armed gang member suspect at 2 de Febrero sector during a police operation aiming to arrest the individual. He resisted authorities and opened fire against the officers starting the clash. During the confrontation the suspect was shot and injured and taken to hospital, but did not survive the injuries. He was involved in drug trafficking. 1 fatality.

On 17 October 2018, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of locals held a man accusing him of having stolen in the Barrio Obrero sector. The individual was with another man who managed to flee. The man was held by the group of locals who also set his motorcycle on fire. The individual was later arrested.

On 20 October 2018, in Maracaibo - Cacique Mara (Zulia), two men were shot and killed by armed men who were in a car at Universidad Av., in the Manzana de Oro neighborhood, Grano de Oro sector, Chiquinquira parish, while they were going to a party in the Amparo neighborhood. On 20 October 2018, in Maracaibo - Cacique Mara (Zulia), a group of locals carried out a demonstration at 78A streets repudiating the killing of two men in the Ampara neighborhood (coded separately), who according to demonstrators were killed by police forces.

Around 26 October 2018 (as reported), in Maracaibo - Juana de Avila (Zulia), a man and a woman were stabbed to death and their bodies were found inside their house in the La Picola apartment complex, in the Juana de Avila parish. Police stated the attack was perpetuated by two armed individuals who fled in a car after the attack. The motivation behind the attack and its perpetrators are unknown. 2 fatalities.

On 9 November 2018, in Valencia (Carabobo), police forces exchanged fire with armed criminal group suspects at Batalla de Carabobo street, near Parque Valencia neighborhood during a police operation. The suspects resisted police forces and opened fire against the officers starting the clash. Three of them were shot and killed during the confrontation. Police seized a pistol, a revolver, and a car that had been stolen by the individuals hours before. 3 fatalities.

On 18 November 2018, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), GNB and police officers shot two CICPC officers at El Dorado Av., killing one of them and injuring the other. The motivation behind the attack are unknown. Two GNB officers were arrested later for the attack. 1 fatality.

notes: Property destruction: Around 25 November 2018 (as reported), in Jesus Maria Semprun municipality (coded to Casigua El Cubo, Zulia), military forces seized 12 tons of cocaine and 14 cocaine processing labs near Socuavo river, in the border area with Colombia. There were no arrests.

Around 9 December 2018, in Caracas - Sucre (Miranda), police forces arrested and beat up a journalist while he was covering an election in the municipality. Police took the victim with them and made him erase all the material he had collected. There were no casualties.

On 20 December 2018, in Pampatar (Nueva Esparta), armed gang members suspects killed five fishermen in the waters of the municipality while the fishermen were working fishing in the area. It is believed the suspects robbed and then killed the victims. No further information was reported. 5 fatalities.

On 19 December 2018, around Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), a group of workers of a private company carried out a demonstration by blocking a cargo of the company demanding Christmas presents for their families, arguing the demand is a right they have as workers of the company. 4 union workers were arrested during the demonstration.

On 1 February 2018, in Mara municipality (coded to Nueva Lucha, Zulia), Zulia state police forces shot and killed two members of the Los Toyoteros Gang, during a theft-related armed clash with three of them. The suspects were travelling in a car to the location where they had parked a truck they had stolen moments earlier, when they were intercepted by a police unit. They resisted authority, a chase ensued, and two of them got injured in the gunfire. Both were pronounced dead in hospital, the third one escaped. The driver of the truck was found inside the vehicle, and liberated safely. 2 fatalities.

On 1 February 2018, in Maracaibo - F. Eugenio Bustamante (Zulia), two unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a man, in an attack occurred in the evening in the Casiano Lossada neighborhood. Police suggest the killing could be a settling of scores. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 31 January 2018, in Cabimas (Zulia), a group of inmates of the Centro de Arrestos y Detenciones Preventivas de la Costa Oriental Lago - Reten de Cabimas prison, hanged and decapitated another prisoner, and took out his heart. It is thought that the killing is a settling of scores perpetrated by members of a rival gang. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 3 February 2018, in Ciudad Ojeda (Zulia), Zulia state police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, during an armed clash with two of them in the Venezuela neighborhood. The suspects resisted authority and initiated a shooting. One of them was injured in the gunfire and pronounced dead in hospital. The other shooter managed to escape through a forested area. Police collected a gun. 1 fatality.

On 4 February 2018, in Mene Grande (Zulia), municipal police forces shot and killed five members of the Los Viatas and the Los Cascaras gangs, including the former's second-in-command, during an armed confrontation in the Curco Hotel, in the Libertador parish. The suspects were being investigated for their participation in the attack on the Mene Grande Mayor's (PSUV) house the week prior (coded separately), and were staying in two rooms of the hotel. They resisted authority and an initial shooting broke out, leaving three injured. Two of the shooters managed to escape, a police chase ensued, and they were shot in a nearby sector. The five suspects were pronounced dead in hospital. Police collected five shotguns. 5 fatalities.

On 6 February 2018, in Maracaibo - Idelfonso Vasquez (Zulia), approximately 20 residents looted a truck loaded with food and diapers, after stopping the vehicle and forcing the driver to open the rear door of the truck, in the Maicaito sector. This event took place in a context of increased violence across the country due to food scarcity and high prices. There were no casualties.

On 6 February 2018, in Maracaibo - Chiquinquira (Zulia), a group of residents looted a truck loaded with food, after stopping the vehicle and forcing the driver to open the rear door of the truck, by the Indio Mara Square. This event took place in a context of increased violence across the country due to food scarcity and high prices. There were no casualties.

On 6 February 2018, in Maracaibo - F. Eugenio Bustamante (Zulia), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed a man outside his mother's house, in a drive-by shooting in the Los Altos sector. The victim had had a dispute with two people in the days prior, and had served a six-year prison sentence in the past. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 6 February 2018, in San Carlos del Zulia (Zulia), Zulia state and Colon municipality police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, a fugitive of the Centro de Arresto y Detenciones de San Carlos - Reten de San Carlos Prison, during an armed clash in the Curicawey sector. The man resisted authority, initiated a shooting, and was injured in the gunfire; he was pronounced dead in hospital. He had escaped from prison on January 2018, where he was serving a sentence for drug trafficking. 1 fatality.

On 7 February 2018, in Santa Rita (Zulia), CICPC police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, during an armed clash in the Don Antonio neighborhood. The suspect resisted authority and opened fire on the officers. He was the perpetrator of the theft related killing of two people, mother and son, the day before in a nearby location. Police collected a gun. 1 fatality.

On 11 February 2018, in Cabimas (Zulia), CICPC police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, a Reten de Cabimas prison fugitive, during an armed clash in the Federacion sector. The suspect was spotted by a patrolling unit by a house, he resisted authority, and a shooting ensued. He was injured in the gunfire and pronounced dead in hospital. The deceased had been serving a prison sentence for extortion until he escaped. Police collected a gun. 1 fatality.

On 12 February 2018, in Los Puertos de Altagracia (Zulia), CICPC police forces shot and killed a member of the El Colla Gang, during an armed clash in the San Crepusculo sector. The suspect resisted authority, initiated a shooting, was injured in the gunfire, and pronounced dead in hospital. He was linked to extortion threats and homicide. Police collected a gun. 1 fatality.

On 12 February 2018, in Maracaibo - Coquivacoa (Zulia), two members of unidentified rival gangs shot and killed each other, during an armed clash in the La Lucha neighborhood. It is thought that they spotted each other in the street, a shootout ensued, and they were both injured in the gunfire and pronounced dead in hospital. One of the deceased was linked to the killing of a man in 2017. There is no further information at this point in time. 2 fatalities.

Around 13 February 2018 (as reported), near La Paz village (Zulia), three Wayuu Indigenous people were shot and killed, and their bodies found with multiple gunshot wounds, in an attack in the Campo Alegre estate, San Antonio sector. It is thought that they were killed the night before, over a settling of scores. There is no further information on the identity of the perpetrators. 3 fatalities.

On 13 February 2018, in El Cruce (Zulia), two unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a disabled man inside his house, in an attack in the Brisas del Catatumbo neighborhood. The suspects arrived at the victim's house on a motorcycle, dismounted, entered the residence, and shot the man multiple times. A cousin of the victim, who was inside the house, was dragged into another room while the attack was taking place. The killing is thought to be a contract killing. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.
