On 14 February 2018, in Caja Seca (Zulia), two unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a teenage girl, and injured her mother, in an attack in their house in the Santa Cruz sector. The suspects arrived on a motorcycle, dismounted, entered the house, and fired multiple shots at the victims before fleeing the area. The girl died at the scene, the mother was taken to hospital for treatment. It is thought that the killing is a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 16 February 2018, in Santo Domingo (Zulia), suspected CICPC police officers shot and killed two men inside their house, in an attack in the Los Azajaritos sector. According to witnesses, a group of at least 60 men who claimed to be CICPC police officers arrived at the house, forced the victims' relatives outside, and then executed the two men. They were pronounced dead in hospital. It is thought that the CICPC police officers were accusing them of having killed two men in 2017. There is no further information at this point in time. 2 fatalities.

On 23 February 2018, in Cano Negro (Zulia), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed two men, father and son, in a drive-by shooting in the Gato Azul sector. The victims were in the company of other people when the attack took place, but no one else was injured. It is thought that the father was linked to criminal groups in the area, although this could not be independently confirmed, and that the killing was a settling of scores. The attackers fled. 2 fatalities.

Around 26 February 2018 (as reported), in San Francisco (Zulia), municipal police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, during an armed clash in the Fundabarrios sector. The suspect resisted authority, initiated a shooting, was injured in the gunfire, and pronounced dead in hospital. The deceased was the perpetrator of the killing of a woman in a nearby location hours earlier (coded separately). Police collected a shotgun. 1 fatality.

On 26 February 2018, in San Francisco (Zulia), unidentified crime group suspects in a car opened fire on the premises of the Super Carners Pepe butchery, during an attack in the San Felipe sector while the shop was still open. The suspects fired multiple shots at the facade of the shop before fleeing the area, injuring an employee and three customers inside, and causing some property damage. It is thought the attack is related to extortion threats. There were no fatalities.

On 27 February 2018, in Maracaibo - San Isidro (Zulia), Zulia state police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, during an armed clash in the El Cebu sector. The authorities linked him to the theft-related killing of two police officers earlier in the month. Relatives of the victim claim that he was not involved in those killings, and that he was unarmed, and argue that his killing was an execution. 1 fatality.

Around 2 February 2018 (as reported), in Tienditas (Tachira), three men were shot and killed, and their bodies found with tied hands, blindfolded, and multiple gunshot wounds to the head, in the San Julian sector. It was later established that two of the victims were Colombian brothers that had gone missing at an unspecified date. There is no further information on the identity or motivations of the perpetrators, but the area is known for the presence of armed groups. 3 fatalities.

On 5 February 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed two men, and injured a girl, in a drive-by shooting in the La Esperanza neighborhood. The two men were intercepted by the perpetrators in the street, and were shot multiple times. One of the victims died at the scene, the other one was pronounced dead in hospital. The girl was just a bystander, she was injured in the crossfire and was not the target of the attack. Police suggest the killings are a settling of scores. 2 fatalities.

On 6 February 2018, in San Cristobal (Tachira), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed a woman by her house, in a drive-by shooting in the La Catedral sector. It was later established that the victim had been lured outside of her house after receiving a phone call. Her partner had been killed in another drive-by shooting in 2017. Her killing could be a settling of scores. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 7 February 2018, in Coloncito (Tachira), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed two men, in a drive-by shooting in the Ambulatorio sector. The victims were also travelling on a motorcycle when they were intercepted by the perpetrators, who shot them multiple times before fleeing the area. The authorities suggest the killings could be a settling of scores. 2 fatalities.

On 7 February 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed a man, in a drive-by shooting. There is no further information at this point in time, but the authorities suggest the killing could be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 8 February 2018, in La Fria (Tachira), several unidentified suspects shot and killed a man, in an attack in the Las Delicias sector. Witnesses claim that the victim was chased by the suspects, who managed to shoot him dead in a nearby location. There is no further information on the identity or motivations of the perpetrators. 1 fatality.

Around 9 February 2018 (as reported), in Villa de Cura (Aragua), two men were shot and killed, and their bodies found by residents in a landfill with multiple gunshot wounds. The authorities suggest the killing is a settling of scores carried out by members of the El Pichon Gang. There is no further information at this point in time. 2 fatalities.

On 23 February 2018, in Urena (Tachira), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle shot and killed a man, in a drive-by shooting in the Intercomunal Avenue. The attackers fled. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

Property destruction: Around 26 February 2018 (as reported), in Jesus Maria Semprun municipality (coded to Casigua El Cubo, Zulia), a contingent of military forces, summoned by the SUNAD anti-drug agency, discovered and destroyed 15 drug labs, thought to belong to unidentified Colombian armed groups linked to drug trafficking and weapon smuggling. During the special operation, the security forces seized a combined total of over 3 tons (3,205 kg) of cocaine, and drug manufacturing products.

On 25 February 2018, in La Tendida (Tachira), two unidentified armed suspects shot and killed a man, in an attack in the vicinity of the Bolivar Square. The suspects intercepted the victim and without any further interaction, they shot him multiple times. The attackers escaped. There is no further information on the identity or motivations of the perpetrators. 1 fatality.

On 26 February 2018, in Colon (Tachira), two unidentified crime group suspects on a motorcycle opened fire on two men, injuring them, in a drive-by shooting in the El Laberinto neighborhood. The victims were taken to hospital for treatment. The attackers escaped. There is no further information at this point in time. There were no fatalities.

On 4 March 2018, in Maracaibo - Olegario Villalobos (Zulia), two unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed two adolescent boys, in an attack occurred in the Cerros de San Martin neighborhood, during a vigil for a private security guard killed in a theft-related shooting the day before. The attackers escaped on a motorcycle. Due to the large number of shots fired at the victims, the authorities suggest the killings could be a settling of scores. 2 fatalities.

On 8 March 2018, in Concepcion (Zulia), several members of the El Jhon Wade Gang shot and killed a man, the owner of a liquor store, in an extortion related attack in the Semeruco sector. The suspects arrived at the victim's house, confirmed his identity, and shot him multiple times. The man had received numerous extortion threats in the past. 1 fatality.

On 28 May 2018, in El Carmelo (Zulia), suspected members of the El Jhon Wade Gang shot and killed a man, in an attack in the El Taparo sector. The suspects spotted their victim, surrounded him, and shot him multiple times without any further interaction. The authorities suspect the killing could be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 11 March 2018, near Concha village (Zulia), unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a man, in an attack in the evening by the La Quinta estate, Paraiso sector, Urribarri parish. The suspects intercepted the victim, opened fire on him without any further interaction, and then escaped. Police suggest the killing could be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 11 March 2018, in Santa Barbara del Zulia (Zulia), several unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a man, in an attack in the La Chamarreta sector. The perpetrators intercepted their victim in the street and opened fire on him multiple times before escaping. The man died while being transported to hospital for treatment. The authorities suggest the killing could be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 13 March 2018, in Pueblo Nuevo (Zulia), several unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a man by his house, in an attack in the Cerro Pelon sector. The suspects arrived at the scene on a car, one of them dismounted, confirmed the identity of the victim, and shot him multiple times. The authorities suggest the killing is a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 14 March 2018, in Maracaibo - Antonio Borjas Romero (Zulia), several armed individuals shot and killed a man that was queuing outside a shop to purchase CLAP subsidized food packages, and injured three others, in an attack in the Cassiona Lossada neighborhood. The suspects had been prowling through the area in a car, dismounted, and opened fire on the crowd. Police suggest the original target of the attack was a man that was also queuing by the shop, and was among the injured. The three injured were taken to hospital for treatment. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

Around 15 March 2018 (as reported), in Bobures (Zulia), Zulia state police forces shot and killed a high-ranking member of the Nino Troconis Gang, during an armed clash by a house in the La Rudale neighborhood. The suspect resisted authority, initiated a shooting, and was killed in the gunfire. He was linked to homicides, violence, and theft. 1 fatality.

On 23 February 2018, in the rural area of Santa Maria village (Zulia), suspect armed members of the Nino Troconis Gang assaulted the workers of a farm in the Brisas del Lago estate, and forced them to hand over 300 bunches of bananas. There were no casualties.

On 16 March 2018, in Caja Seca (Zulia), Zulia state police forces shot and killed a member of the Nino Troconis Gang, during an armed clash in the Los Samanes de Santa Cruz neighborhood. Police arrived at the scene after receiving information that a group of armed men had gathered in the area. After spotting the officers, all the suspects except one escaped. The remaining gang member resisted authority, initiated a shooting, was injured in the gunfire, and pronounced dead in hospital. The deceased was linked to thefts in the area. Police collected a gun. 1 fatality.

On 18 March 2018, in San Carlos del Zulia (Zulia), a joint unit of Zulia state and CICPC police forces shot and killed the leader of the El Boli Gang, and arrested three other high-ranking members, during an armed clash in the Los Altos sector. The suspects resisted authority and initiated a shooting. The leader of the gang was injured in the gunfire and pronounced dead in hospital. Three high-ranking members were arrested. All the suspects were linked to homicides, violence, and theft. Police collected a shotgun and a gun. 1 fatality.

On 19 March 2018, in Maracaibo - Cristo de Aranza (Zulia), Zulia state police forces shot and killed an unidentified crime group suspect, and arrested two others, during an armed clash in the Los Haticos 2 sector. The suspects resisted authority and attempted to escape. One of them opened fire on the officers, was injured in the gunfire, and pronounced dead in hospital. The other two were arrested. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

Around 20 March 2018 (as reported), in Santa Rita municipality (coded to Santa Rita, Zulia), the owner of a shrimp farm was shot and killed, and his body found by the Troncal 17 Lara - Zulia road, in the Las Malvinas sector. According to relatives of the victim, the man was being extorted by an unidentified gang. Police suggest the killing could be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 20 March 2018, in Maracaibo - Antonio Borjas Romero (Zulia), three unidentified crime group suspects shot and killed a man, in an attack in the Manantial de Luz neighborhood. The suspects intercepted their victim in the street, and opened fire on him without any further interaction; he was pronounced dead in hospital. The deceased had a criminal record for bearing firearms, although it is unknown whether he was involved in criminal group activity. Police suggest the killing could be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 23 March 2018, in San Francisco (Zulia), three unidentified armed suspects shot and killed a man in his house, in an attack in the El Saman neighborhood. The suspects arrived at the victim's home on a car and a motorcycle, dismounted, and entered the premises under the pretext of being police officers. Inside, they confirmed his identity, dragged him into another room, shot him twelve times, and then escaped. The victim's wife witnessed the execution. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 22 March 2018, in Maracaibo - Raul Leoni (Zulia), a vigilante group of residents of the Curva de Molina sector lynched two adolescent boys, and injured another, who they accused of carrying out thefts in the area. The soldiers collected an assault rifle, two guns, two grenades, and ammunition. There is no further information at this point in time. 3 fatalities.

The Bolivarian Police surveilled the protest.

On 12 March 2018, in Motatan (Trujillo), a group of residents demonstrated over the power outages they were suffering. Several demonstrators attempted to loot a shop located in the town's main avenue, in the Caja de Agua neighborhood. Residents of the sector responded by throwing rocks at the demonstrators, injuring one. The victim was pronounced dead a few hours later in hospital. 1 fatality.

The victims were travelling in a vehicle when the policemen, on patrol, opened fire on them. The teenage boy was killed on the spot, whereas the adult attempted to escape, but was shot dead by the police forces. Initially, the policemen argued the killings stemmed from a robbery, but their excuse was later deemed false, and they were all arrested and charged for homicide. 2 fatalities.

notes: On 8 December 2018, in the Canaima National Park (Bolivar), a unit of 14 DGCIM military officers shot and killed a Pemon Indigenous man from the Arekuna Indigenous community, and injured two others, during a security operation against illegal mining in a remote area known as the Los Arenales del Rio Carrao, in Campo Carrao, Kamarata sector. According to witnesses, the soldiers initially resembled tourists, despite ultimately being heavily armed, and arrived in the area in three helicopters. In retaliation, a group of Pemon Indigenous people took three of the perpetrators hostage for several hours, during which they interrogated and beat up the soldiers, and set fire to a Corpoelec power company fuel depot (coded separately). 1 fatality.

On 16 July 2018, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), a group of residents rioted during a demonstration over the outages of power and drinking water that they were suffering. Some of the demonstrators attempted to loot the premises of a business, while others threw petrol bombs at a police station by the Bicentenario de Chirica municipal market. Police forces employed live ammunition to disperse the rioters, and killed a teenage boy. Four Bolivar state police officers were arrested for perpetrating the killing. 1 fatality.

On 10 January 2018, in La Yuca (Merida), a group of residents rioted during a demonstration over food scarcity which they blamed on the Local Committees for Supply and Production (CLAP) governmental food distribution body. A group of demonstrators attempted to loot a truck in the Troncal 1 road. Several unidentified individuals (likely colectivo members) appeared on scene and opened fire on the looters, killing one. 1 fatality.

On 10 January 2018, in Arapuey (Merida), a group of residents rioted during a demonstration over food scarcity which they blamed on the Local Committees for Supply and Production (CLAP) governmental food distribution body. Several unidentified individuals (likely colectivo members) appeared on the scene and opened fire on the demonstrators, killing a teenage boy. 1 fatality.

On 8 March 2018, in Barcelona (Anzoategui), a group of residents of the La Ponderosa neighborhood protested over food shortages and the disruption of the Local Committees for Supply and Production (CLAP) governmental food distribution service. Part of the demonstrators attempted to block the Troncal 9 highway, but several policemen arrived at the scene and employed live ammunition to disperse the peaceful protesters. A demonstrator was killed and the three perpetrating officers were arrested. 1 fatality.

On 7 March 2018, in La Luz (Barinas), a group of residents protested over food and power shortages. Barinas state police arrived on scene and dispersed the peaceful protesters with live ammunition, killing one. 1 fatality.

Several rioters attempted to loot a food shop after its owner refused to comply with the state-regulated prices. Zulia state police forces appeared on scene and employed live ammunition to disperse the crowd. A passer-by was shot and killed, the perpetrating officer was arrested. 1 fatality.

The representative had been denouncing the problems with gold mining in the Mining Arc and it is believed the attack was a revenge due to the claims the former representative was making. Six police policers were later charged for the killing. 2 fatalities.

No arrests were reported. 1 fatality.

An inmate was killed and an estimate of 16 others were reported injured after a grenade, in hands of a prisoner, accidentally detonated. Some reports claim that, on the contrary, there was no riot, just the accidental grenade detonation. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 6 February 2021, in El Vigia (Merida), prisoners provoked unrest at the Police Coordination Center N.8 after starting a fight in the early hours over the control of the cells. An inmate was killed as a result and 10 others were reported injured with knives and firearms. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

The family also accuses the policemen of staying inside their home for over four hours, rearranging the scene so as to make the killing resemble an armed confrontation, and that they stole some kitchen appliances. 1 fatality.

Around 26 July 2018 (as reported), in Caracas - Libertador (Distrito Capital), a man was arrested by national police forces at Cagilones de La Vega locality, in the El Combate neighborhood and later shot to death. Relatives of the victim stated the victim was shot by police officers who arrived in three motorcycle to arrest the victim. 1 fatality.

On 27 March 2021, near Maripa town, Sucre municipality (Bolivar), a couple were killed by the ELN in El Kino mine in the Aripao parish. Several communities and organizations have reported the presence of armed groups in the area, where they wield control of the illegal mining. 2 fatalities.

The motivation of the crime could be a settling of scores, although investigations were ongoing. 1 fatality.

Around 10 June 2022 (as reported), in Santo Domingo (Tachira), a leading member of the ELN was shot and killed by unknown armed men and his body found on the side of a road. The area is known for an ongoing conflict between the ELN and various FARC dissident fronts. 1 fatality.

On 12 October 2022, in Guatire (Miranda), a group of prisoners of the Rodeo prison beat another inmate to death. The deceased had been accused of sexually abusing and killing a girl, which possibly motivated the attack. 1 fatality.

Around 31 August 2023 (as reported), in Los Cortijos (Zulia), CICPC police forces shot and killed a member of the El Mauricio gang during an armed clash in the Santa Fe neighborhood. The man was linked to unspecified extortion-related attacks. There is no further information at this point in time. 1 fatality.

On 9 July 2020, in Maracaibo - Idelfonso Vasquez (Zulia), a gang member engaged in an armed confrontation with Zulia state police in the Mirtha Fonseca sector. The gang member was shot and killed. He belonged to a gang involved in extortion and house robberies in the north of Maracaibo, and was wanted for arson. 1 fatality.
On 16 July 2020, in Casigua (Falcon), two unidentified armed assailants shot and killed a man in drive-by shooting. Cicpc officers treat the event as a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 8 August 2020, in Santa Ana del Tachira (Tachira), several unidentified armed assailants shot and killed one man and wounded another in the Teo Camargo sector. The victims were shot at numerous times. 1 fatality.

On 10 August 2020, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), a group of unidentified armed assailants shot a man in the head and killed him in the Libertador neighbourhood, Luis Hurtado Higuera sector, Chirica parish, San Felix. Around 10 August 2020, in Coro (Falcon), an infant was killed and dismembered and his body was found in a plastic bag in the Zumurucuare sector. The body was missing arms and legs. 1 fatality.

On 16 August 2020, in Coro (Falcon), two men were killed in an armed confrontation with Cicpc officers who were carrying out an investigation on extortion activities in the Ignacio Sarmiento housing estate. 2 fatalities.

notes: On 21 August 2020, in Coro (Falcon), FAES officers shot and killed a man after a car chase that ended in in the Monsenor Iturriza housing estate. The event is one of three killings at the hands of the FAES within one week (coded separately). 1 fatality.

On 24 August 2020, in Caicara del Orinoco (Bolivar), unidentified armed assailants shot a man several times in the Chaguaramal sector. The victim died on the scene and his body was found face down in front of a house in the area. Officials presume the event to be a settling of scores. 1 fatality.

On 26 August 2020, near Punto Fijo (Falcon), three members of the El Chaca gang engaged in an armed confrontation with police officers in the La Jungla neighbourhood. The gang members had just committed a robbery of civilians on a bus. One gang member was killed and one wounded in the exchange of fire, but two managed to escape. 1 fatality.

On 28 August 2020, in San Francisco (Zulia), two armed assailants engaged in an armed confrontation during a chase with police officers in the El Sabilar sector. The armed assailant riding the motorcycle was injured and died, while the driver of the motorcycle escaped. The victim was likely a member of a local gang. 1 fatality.

On 29 August 2020, in Maracaibo - Coquivacoa (Zulia), at least nine members of the El Cojo gang engaged in an armed confrontation with police officers during an investigation in the Santa Rosa sector. Four gang members were shot and died in the clash, while five others were detained. 4 fatalities.

On 2 September 2020, in San Cristobal (Tachira), a group of four men beat a man to death in the Monsenor Ramirez neighborhood. The victim had severed bruises on his body. The men were reportedly practicing vigilante justice by beating the man because he had disrespected a woman. 1 fatality.

On 2 September 2020, in Maracaibo - Antonio Borjas Romero (Zulia), a member of the El Joel gang exchanged fire with police officers and was killed in the El Marite neighborhood. The gang is involved in extortion and contract killings. 1 fatality.

On 7 September 2020, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), numerous assailants beat a man to death by beating him with blunt objects on Calle San Martin in the Las Americas sector of San Felix. On 7 September 2020, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), a woman was gagged, tied up, and stabbed to death in her home in the Vista al Rio community, in the Mini Fincas sector of Puerto Ordaz. 1 fatality.
On 8 September 2020, in Maracaibo - Cecilio Acosta (Zulia), an armed assailant involved in extortion was killed in an armed clash with Cicpc officers in the Cecilio Acosta parish. 1 fatality.

On 10 September 2020, in Ciudad Guayana (Bolivar), several armed assailants shot and killed a man in a drive-by shooting in Puente Orinoquia, Puerto Ordaz. Around 5 January 2020, near La Fria (Tachira), two men were killed and their bodies found in La Urraca sector, with several bullets. The identity of perpetrators was unknown, but eye-witnesses claim this act was an homicide for hire. 2 fatalities.

On 6 January 2020, in La Fria (Tachira), several unidentified armed men attacked and killed two workers on the Panamericana highway. The victims were working at a car shop when the attackers shot and killed them. Motivation unknown. 2 fatalities.

On 6 January 2020, near Maracaibo municipality (Zulia), two unidentified armed men shot and killed a human rights defender in sector Los Plataneros, Cumbres de Maracaibo.
